import sys, asyncio, inspect
sys.path.insert(0, \"src\")
import click
from click.testing import CliRunner
print(\"local click\", click.__version__, click.__file__)
seen=[]
@click.command()
@click.pass_context
async def cli(ctx):
    seen.append(click.get_current_context(silent=True) is ctx)
    return 42
r=CliRunner().invoke(cli, standalone_mode=False)
assert inspect.iscoroutine(r.return_value) and not seen
print(\"runner result\", r.exit_code, \"coroutine\", inspect.iscoroutine(r.return_value), \"body executed\", bool(seen))
print(\"await after runner\", asyncio.run(r.return_value), \"context present\", seen)
async def interleaving():
    ready=asyncio.Event(); release=asyncio.Event()
    a=click.Context(click.Command(\"a\")); b=click.Context(click.Command(\"b\"))
    async def first():
        with a:
            ready.set()
            await release.wait()
            print(\"task a current context\", click.get_current_context().info_name, \"is b\", click.get_current_context() is b)
    async def second():
        await ready.wait()
        with b:
            release.set()
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
    await asyncio.gather(first(), second())
asyncio.run(interleaving())
print(\"remaining context\", click.get_current_context(silent=True))
'"
